title: Agave House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set in the sought-after Prominence community along Florida’s scenic 30A, this luxurious four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom beach house is designed for effortless coastal living. With stylish interiors, two serene primary suites, and ample room for up to 10 guests, the home blends relaxation and sophistication at every turn. The open-concept living space features a large smart TV and a well-appointed kitchen with a breakfast bar—perfect for slow mornings or evening gatherings. Outdoors, guests will love the spacious driveway, furnished balcony, and access to a 6-seater golf cart and four bikes, making beach days and neighborhood exploring a breeze. Enjoy captivating views of both the Gulf and the resort-style pool, located just steps from your door. Whether biking along 30A’s scenic paths or strolling to The Big Chill for live music and casual dining, every day offers something new. Families will especially appreciate the kid-friendly bunk room, two zero-entry pools, and the walkable access to movie nights, boutique shops, and vibrant local eateries. With high-speed Wi-Fi, full laundry, and thoughtful touches throughout, this home is a welcoming retreat crafted for unforgettable moments on Florida’s Emerald Coast.
